notes: The PU-12M on its BTR-60PB hull as a body to climb: where each seat's crewman stands up, the roof hatches over the front seats, the roof, the ways down over the wheels, the places round it (the AB-1 set behind, the PAB-2 aiming circle ahead) and the jobs done there. Body frame as data/cabins/pu12m.json: x right, y forward, z up, metres, origin on the ground at the middle of the wheelbase (the exterior trace's X forward, Y left: x = -Y).
source: tools/blender/pu12m_trace.py (the hull, the roof hatches, the mast, the roof box); tools/blender/pu12m_interior_trace.py (the equipment under the hatches); fair_btr_compare and vk_btr60 (the BTR-60PB's troops get out by the roof hatches; two side hatches high in the sides)

areas.notes: The flat roof (half-width 1.06 m) from the engine deck's grilles (X -1.45) to the roof's front corner (2.30).

hull.source: valka_pu12 (7220 mm long, 2825 wide, 2055 to the top of the armour); tools/blender/pu12m_trace.py (ROOF_HALF_W, the roof's corners, the engine grilles)

keep_out.why: The mast's foot and winch come up through the roof; raised, it stands guyed (csla_pu12_manual item 10)
keep_out.source: csla_pu12_manual (item 10, the mast through the roof); tools/blender/pu12m_trace.py (MAST_X, MAST_Y: 2.30 m behind the bow, 0.63 m to the right; the base section 7.5 cm in radius)

keep_out.why: The roof box in place of the turret stands 0.65 m above the roof

seats.notes: Along the bench's knee room to the gap between the R-111 and the ДХ keypad (x -0.17 to 0.08), under the folded map board, up the aisle between the telecode units to the front seats (tools/blender/pu12m_interior_trace.py).

exits.label: The squad leader's roof hatch
exits.source: tools/blender/pu12m_trace.py ROOF_HATCHES (over the front seats, 0.5 x 0.5 m, scaled from the photographs and csla_pu12_manual's plan); the times: sam3d estimate
exits.notes: The BTR-60PB's middle roof hatch on the right stands over the IT-45 (its top 1.92 m under a 2.025 m ceiling) and the side hatches over the RK-3 and the ФР block (tools/blender/pu12m_interior_trace.py): the bench crew can't climb out there, so SAM3D sends them forward to the front hatches (a SAM3D inference from the trace).

exits.label: The driver's roof hatch
exits.source: tools/blender/pu12m_trace.py ROOF_HATCHES; the times: sam3d estimate

places.notes: Behind the tripod, looking back at the post.

jobs.notes: Setting it out and taking it back in are done at the set; he stays while it is lifted down, earthed and cabled (ab1_placed).
